what_is_this: A web toy where you press a clay monkey whose body is sealed bags of water: pressing spikes the touched cell's pressure gauge (my press-hold read 0.479 MPa on the torso cell), letting go heals it back to zero, and short lessons teach the touch language. The numbers panel ('THE CREATURE'S BLOOD') conserves volume while pressures move.
novelty_line: A stress ball with an honest gradebook: I have pressed many virtual pets, but never one whose belly carries a pressure gauge that obeys conservation and heals itself when I let go.
quotes: I pressed it and the gauge told the truth: 0.479 MPa under my hand, then zero when I let go — the water is real.
Lesson 2 asked for a gentle hand and then locked the gentleness behind a slider that would not move — the lesson is unplayable as taught.
It healed itself and never needed me; after the third squish I had felt everything the toy has.
